token.costGuideText: It's normal for ~90% of costs to come from cache (write + read). Curious why cache is essential and how to manage it?

chart.effNote: * Days with <1,000 output tokens are excluded (too small a denominator skews the ratio).
chart.hourlyNoteActive: * Active days: average cost only on days you actually used this hour.
chart.hourlyNoteAll: * All days: spread across every calendar day in the period (including days off).
chart.hourlyNotePartial: * Boundary hours that don't fill a full 60 minutes are normalized to 1 hour.
chart.dowNoteActive: * Active days: average only on weeks you worked that day.
chart.dowNoteAll: * All days: divided by total occurrences of that weekday in the period (each weekday may have a different count).
chart.dowNotePartial: * Boundary days that don't fill a full 24 hours are normalized to 1 day.
chart.ctxNote: * Lower context = cheaper per call. Keeping context small via /clear or /continue saves cost.
chart.ctxCostTitleCW: 💸 Cost by Context Size — Cache Write (CW)
chart.ctxCostTitleNonCW: 💸 Cost by Context Size — Non-CW (Cache Read / Output)
chart.ctxCostTitleTurn: 💸 Cost by Context Size — Per User Turn
chart.ctxCostCWNote1: * Cache write is the most expensive token type — occurs when cache expires (1h+ idle) or after /resume, --continue.
chart.ctxCostCWNote2: * Lines: ── 1-hour cache write, ╌ 5-min cache write, ··· cache read.
chart.ctxCostCWNote3: * Line colors by model: red tones = Opus, blue tones = Sonnet, green tones = Haiku.
chart.ctxCostNonCWNote1: * API calls where cache write is NOT the dominant cost (cache read, output, or input dominant).
chart.ctxCostNonCWNote2: * Dotted lines = cache read price per model. Points below may use a cheaper model.
chart.ctxCostTurnNote1: * Each bubble = aggregated cost of one user prompt (all API calls combined), sized by density.
chart.ctxCostTurnNote2: * ✳ Stars = turns exceeding $50 (capped for display — hover for actual cost).
chart.ctxCostTitle: Context Size vs High-Cost API Calls ($1+)

alert.ctxWarn: ⚠️ Context window exceeded 35% — cache write/read cost increases with each call.
alert.ctxDanger: 🔴 Context window exceeded 70% — cache write/read cost is very high.
alert.continueSkillTip: 💡 We recommend /continue skill after a new session.
alert.cacheWritePrefix: {icon} In this call, cache write {tokens} tokens were newly cached —
alert.compactManualReason: /compact manually invoked, cache regenerated — large cost! Consider /continue skill for lighter context restoration.
alert.compactAutoReason: /compact fired automatically due to context pressure. Cache was regenerated.
alert.pluginOverload: — too many plugins, MCP, or skills may be loaded. Keep only what you need.
alert.reloadReason: /reload-plugins caused system prompt change, cache regenerated (${cost})
alert.resumeHeuristicReason: Resuming a session with claude --continue or /resume uses a lot of tokens. Unless necessary, we recommend /continue skill after a new session.
alert.cacheExpiredReason: When context is large and over 1 hour has passed, new cache is generated — large cost!
alert.costCacheReadLabel: {icon} Cache read cost is high. Large context ({ctx}) with many consecutive tool calls ({calls}) multiplies cost. (${cost})
alert.costOutputReason: {icon} Output {tokens} dominated cost (${cost}) — consider using Edit (diff) instead of full file rewrites, and trim verbose explanations in your prompt.
alert.costInputReason: {icon} Input {tokens} dominated cost (${cost}) — consider using text instead of images, reading only needed sections with offset/limit, or providing summarized context.

gitLite.tip: Tip: CC's built-in git instructions consume ~2,200 tok/session + ~1,700 tok/call. `/setup-git-lite install` replaces them with a curated 280-tok minimum. `/setup-git-lite dismiss-banner` hides this tip.
